persons.name: Niṣṭhānanda
persons.evidence: dvijavaravaṃśaśrīniṣṭhānandanaṃ putrapautrapanista dhakā coyā tayā julo

date.as_written: nepālasamvat 1026 miti kārttikakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ tithau hastanakṣatre, prītiyoge, bālakarṇṇasuhūtre, guruvārasare, viccharāśigate savittare, tularāśigate candramasi

notes: Niṣṭhānanda is likely Niṣṭhānanda Vajrācārya (a renowned figure of the Nepal Bhasa renaissance) or a Brahmin if dvijavara is literal, who copied/prepared the manuscript for his descendants (putrapautrapanista dhakā coyā tayā julo).
